title: Purrspective
tagline: Shrink it. Grow it. Climb it. A masked cat changes the size of anything to reach the top of the city.
details: Adventure platformer · Windows · Release date to be announced · English, Norwegian
about: You're a masked cat who can change the size of anything. Scale objects around you to climb buildings and reach the top of the city.
Collect powerups and become stronger to reach new heights, help the citizens of this wacky world, and see how big or small you can make the objects around you.
features: Shrink or grow the objects around you
Climb your way to the top of the city
Powerups that let you reach new heights
Hand-drawn characters in a full 3D world
